title: Canonical URL broken on all pages — always points to /
description: Every page renders <link rel="canonical" href="https://voxpelli.com/"> regardless of actual URL. Root cause: DomStack doesn't pass pageUrl to layouts for directly-rendered pages. vars.pageUrl is empty/falsy, defaults to '/'. See domstack-issues/12-pageurl-not-available-in-layouts.md. Harms SEO and IndieWeb URL discovery.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Article pages have correct canonical URL matching their path
- [ ] u-url/u-uid hrefs are non-empty on post footers
- [ ] Webmention form target includes page path, not just siteUrl
close_reason: Fixed: layouts now destructure page param from DomStack and derive pageUrl from page.path. Canonical URLs, OG URLs, webmention targets all correct.

title: FOWT inline script broken — htm entity-encodes inside <script> tag

Fix: use rawHtml() for the script content or embed as a raw string outside the htm template.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Inline FOWT script renders as valid JS (no HTML entities)
- [ ] Page loads with correct data-theme before CSS paints
- [ ] No console errors from the inline script

Original: Post cards hide MIN READ badge because vars.content is empty during global.data.js aggregation.

title: Nav scroll lock leaks when resizing mobile→desktop with drawer open
description: body.style.overflow='hidden' stays stuck on desktop because setNavOpen's isMobile() gate skips the clear branch when the MQ change listener fires past the breakpoint. WCAG 1.4.10 regression. Fix: make overflow lock unconditional on the (open && isMobile()) expression.

title: Retarget syntax highlighting CSS from Rouge to highlight.js classes

The entire theme is dead CSS. Retarget to .hljs token classes or use a highlight.js CSS theme file. The dark mode color tokens (--hl-bg, --hl-comment, etc.) are already defined — just the selectors need updating.
close_reason: Replaced 28 dead Rouge/Jekyll selectors with 18 working highlight.js selectors targeting actual built output classes

title: markdown-it.settings.js — structural wrappers for rich content
description: Create src/markdown-it.settings.js with render rules: html_block wraps bare <iframe> in div.video-embed, image wraps titled images in figure/figcaption, fence wraps code blocks in div.code-block, table_open/table_close wraps tables in div.table-wrapper. Add matching CSS for all wrapper classes. Zero new dependencies. DomStack convention: export default async function(md) { return md }. See Content Architecture BM note for rationale (newsdoc thinking applied to markdown).
design: Four markdown-it renderer rule overrides applied at build time. Source stays plain markdown. Wrappers are purely additive — an unstyled iframe still embeds. CSS classes: .video-embed (aspect-ratio: 16/9), .code-block (overflow-x: auto), .table-wrapper (overflow-x: auto), figure/figcaption.

title: Fix null-safety type error in RelativeTime web component

title: Add extractFullDomain utility and fix extractName TLD handling

title: Console error: Unexpected token ampersand
description: Browser-sync dev server artifact — the '&' in bunny.net font URL is correctly HTML-encoded as & in attributes, but browser-sync's injection script may misparse it. Not present in production builds. Downgraded to P4 (backlog).
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] No 'Unexpected token ampersand' console error on page load
- [ ] Root cause identified and fixed
close_reason: Not a code bug. The built HTML correctly encodes & as & in the font URL attribute (public/index.html line 19). This is required by the HTML spec for ampersands in attribute values. Browsers parse it back to & when fetching the URL. The console error is a browser-sync dev server artifact — its script injection misparses the & entity. Production builds are unaffected.
